scope: Public Higgsfield API additions relevant to Reelform's video studio

integration.billing: Round output duration up to whole seconds. Use standard prices; temporary discounts and cashback are not assumed.
integration.verification: Documented schemas, local unit tests, and browser contract tests with simulated services. Account access and paid generation output are not verified.

katana.publishedAccess: Preset workflow through MCP and Claude
katana.status: No documented public REST endpoint verified in the current API catalog. Do not infer unavailability solely from the supplementary OpenAPI specification.
katana.templateRedistributionPermission: Not verified for the Katana gallery assets
requiredBeforeIntegration: Documented developer endpoint and account access, request schema and billing
Asset-specific permission for external hosting, commercial display, and reuse, including audio and likeness rights
Branding and attribution requirements for any proposed Reelform feature name

otherCatalogFindings.status: Not added: documented request schema has no video input or generated-audio toggle; requires a separate creation-only UI and audio handling.
Not added: documented 2K output is outside Reelform's existing resolution and plan contracts.

rightsReview.apiTermsFinding: Developer applications must add material functionality. Standalone or substantially similar/competing generation services require prior written consent. Reelform's commercial model needs review against these restrictions; API access is not permission to resell.
rightsReview.brandingAndAssetsFinding: Commercial use of one's own outputs does not establish rights to redistribute gallery examples. Preserve proprietary notices and required attribution; do not imply endorsement. No blanket Katana rebranding permission was verified.
rightsReview.openWorksFinding: Applies only to works actually released under that license with their creator notice and asset exclusions. Its existence does not license the whole Katana gallery.
